notes: Trigger-only evals. This skill drives a live Facebook session, so end-to-end output cannot be benchmarked deterministically; triage.py is covered separately by tests/check_triage.sh. These cases exercise description triggering (should-trigger vs should-not-trigger), including negatives against the resell-au selling skills, which also drive Facebook.

evals.prompt: check the facebook groups for anything new, I need a place in Haarlem
expectations: Sweeps the groups in groups.json and shows only posts not already in seen.json

evals.prompt: find me a temporary apartment in Amsterdam for about 4 months
anything new in the housing groups since last week?
expectations: Uses seen.json to drop already-seen posts

evals.prompt: put all the flats I haven't looked at yet into a table so I can compare them
expectations: Runs triage.py and prints the comparison table

evals.prompt: ik zoek tijdelijke woonruimte in Haarlem, kun je de facebook groepen checken?
shortlist the first two and draft a message to both landlords
expectations: Sets verdict to shortlisted in seen.json
Drafts the message but does NOT send it without explicit approval

evals.prompt: show me places up to 3000 a month, I'll stretch the budget
expectations: Passes --max-rent 3000 rather than editing the skill defaults

evals.prompt: list my coffee table on facebook marketplace
go through my marketplace messages and tell me who's picking up what
how much is my old bike worth?
what's a fair rent for a 60m2 flat in Amsterdam Oost?
expectations: Plain answer or a web search; no group sweep, since nothing asks to check the groups
